assertions.name: alpha_em_habiro_is_bar_involution_fixed_point
assertions.source: H = [2]_q·(1−h²α) satisfies H(1/q) = H(q) exactly over the FORMAL fibre variable (no reality assumed) — it is a fixed point of the bar involution q↦q⁻¹ (the framework/tower involution structure). This is the clean charge-conjugation sector PR #1602 requires; reality enters only at q₀.

assertions.name: alpha_em_habiro_zero_at_zeta4
assertions.source: H(ζ_4) = H(q=i) = 0 exactly — α_EM's modular node, the dual of Q_β's ζ_4 pole (PR #1622).

description: Apply the Q_β q-difference / root-of-unity / Fourier machinery (PRs #1593/#1602/#1622) to the α_EM Habiro element H = [2]_q·(1−h²α) = (q+q⁻¹)(1−(q−q⁻¹)²α). Computes the exact root-of-unity spectrum H(ζ_d) (the Fourier modes of σ_q), the special values H(ζ_1)=2 (classical α/4π), H(ζ_2)=−2 (bar mode), H(ζ_4)=0 (a ZERO — vs Q_β's pole), confirms H is a fixed point of the bar involution q↦q⁻¹ over the FORMAL fibre variable (the charge-conjugation-symmetric sector PR #1602 requires; not a reality assumption — reality enters only at the archimedean q₀ step), and reproduces the established h-Taylor recursion + q₀ truncation. Exact symbolic; sharpens the α_EM modular target, no closure of the open derived form.

habiro_element.h_basis: h = q − q⁻¹ (Hecke differential; distinct from Habiro u=q^{1/2} and ladder u_ladder=b·ℏ²)
habiro_element.level_note: fibre-level: q,α formal (Im unconstrained), bar involution q↦q⁻¹ is the structural object; reality of observable component imposed ONLY at archimedean q₀ evaluation. Per AGENTS.md Im(q) fibre-vs-observable.

special_values.contrast_with_qbeta: α_EM has a ZERO at ζ_4; Q_β had a POLE at ζ_4 (PR #1622) — dual modular nodes

interpretation.open: α_EM next-order derived form (alpha-em ledger) — modular target sharpened (H(ζ_4)=0 node), not closed
